translations.web: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
translations.bsb: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
translations.asv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not near a woman.
